label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method rubric design details. Core rubric criteria with objective pass/fail conditions: Factual accuracy (all claims verifiable against source material or common knowledge), Hallucination-free (no fabricated entities, quotes, URLs, references), Completeness (every requirement in spec addressed), Compliance (passes project-specific constraints), Internal consistency (no contradictions within output), Technical correctness (code compiles/runs, algorithms sound). Domain-specific extensions: Content/Marketing (brand voice adherence, SEO requirements, no competitor trademark misuse, CTA present), Code (type safety, error handling coverage, security, test coverage), Compliance-Sensitive (no outcome guarantees, required disclaimers, approved terminology, jurisdiction-appropriate language). Reviewer prompt explicitly states 'Your job is to find problems, not to approve.' Structured JSON output with verdict, checks array, critical_issues, suggestions.
